summary: Hut 8 Corp filed an 8-K regarding its subsidiary Beacon Point DC LLC's issuance of $4.25 billion in 6.129% senior secured notes due 2042 under Rule 144A/Regulation S. The Notes were issued at par to finance a 352 MW data center in Texas, lease a high-investment-grade tenant (AA- rated), fund reserves, and pay fees. Interest is semi-annual, principal amortizes from 2030. This is a debt financing, not a special situation. No change of control, tender, or restructuring is involved; it is routine capital-raising for project development.
